answer: A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors as a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. The lantern record keeps the spread, spiral schedules the escalation, and sable publishes the outcome. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 3 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 337 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
